kind: ADDITIVE. Offline fit of exactly three preregistered candidates. No rollout, episode, collection, promotion, sigma or production change
authorised_after: architect review of S1C-0 PASS; verdict REACHABLE accepted within its scope

init.exclusive: S0D ONLY, reloaded fresh and digest-verified per candidate

objective.form: L = r * mean_anchor(row MSE vs u_S0D) + 1 * WEIGHTED_mean_task(row MSE vs u_IK) + 1.0 * clip + 1e-5 * July parametric anchor
objective.task_weighting: w_i = w on PUSH-OFF rows, 1 elsewhere; the task term is the WEIGHTED MEAN sum(w_i*mse_i)/sum(w_i) over the task rows present in the batch, so it stays a per-role mean and the meaning of r is preserved
objective.push_off_definition_frozen: rows whose decoded AB06 IK ankle target q = 0.7*u_IK[:,1] is NEGATIVE (plantarflexion). Count on the 380 training rows: 73 rows (19.2%)
objective.group_balanced: T1R mechanism: one deterministic shuffled union of the two 380-row role blocks; per-role means computed separately inside every batch; an absent role contributes exactly zero and such batches are counted

binding_offline_gates.which: the rev3s hierarchy I -> P -> T -> D, fail-closed with short circuit and discrete strata, thresholds UNCHANGED
binding_offline_gates.why_not_G1_G5: the rev3v quality gates G1..G5 are defined on a CLOSED-LOOP trace (realised joint angles, FSM counters). No rollout is authorised here, so they CANNOT be evaluated in this stage and are not claimed
binding_offline_gates.meaning_of_pass: admitted to a future closed-loop gate under its own token; never walking, never promotion

G2_G4_offline_surrogates_non_binding.rule: reported for the architect's G2-G4 comparison, computed in COMMANDED-JOINT space on the frozen 500 S0D-visited rows: q_cmd = decode(policy action) versus the decoded IK target and versus the healthy contralateral signal
G2_G4_offline_surrogates_non_binding.status: SURROGATE ONLY. It is not the rev3v gate, it cannot substitute it, and it may never promote a candidate
G2_G4_offline_surrogates_non_binding.baselines_recorded: the same surrogates computed for S0D and for A2, so the comparison is like-for-like

preregistered_causal_diagnostic.purpose: decide whether the phase weight produces a command that is negative LONGER, not merely deeper
preregistered_causal_diagnostic.data: the ORDERED frozen holdout rows, steps 201-300, never trained on by either role
metrics_frozen_before_execution: duty cycle: fraction of held-out rows whose commanded decoded ankle target is negative
run lengths of consecutive negative-command rows: count, mean, max
minimum and mean of the commanded decoded ankle target

predicted served reference obtained by feeding the candidate's commanded actions, in temporal order, through the rev3w VALIDATED production replica (slew limiter + third-order jerk-limited model): min, fraction negative, final value
preregistered_causal_diagnostic.declared_limitation: the held-out STATES are the ones S0D visited. Driving them with another actor's actions is an OPEN-LOOP COUNTERFACTUAL: it predicts what the reference path would do on those states, NOT what the candidate would visit in closed loop
preregistered_causal_diagnostic.B3_rule: a rigorous B3 verdict is IMPOSSIBLE here because the phase field pros_ankle_angle_imitation_target_phase is identically zero on every v3 trace. The B3-specific part of this diagnostic is therefore marked INDETERMINATE and may NEVER promote a candidate or act as a gate
preregistered_causal_diagnostic.not_a_gate: this diagnostic is descriptive; it is preregistered here, before any result is seen, and its thresholds are deliberately absent

mandatory_flags.promotion_requires: closed-loop nominal rollout under a separate token

B3_blocker_unchanged: the null phase field remains a SEPARATE open blocker for G5; no production or logging change is made now
prohibitions: no threshold adapted after seeing results
